guide.summary: Rizal Park's national museums, Intramuros fort sites and Makati and BGC galleries, with breakfast spots, bakeries, coffee, dinners and hotel bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: The Mind Museum and the Metropolitan Museum of Manila are closed on Mondays, but the National Museum says its Manila buildings open Monday to Sunday, 9 AM to 6 PM, with free admission.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The Mind Museum and the Metropolitan Museum of Manila are closed on Mondays, while the National Museum says its Manila buildings open Monday to Sunday. The Champagne Room at The Manila Hotel is closed on Sundays, and Toyo Eatery serves Tuesday to Saturday only.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: The Mind Museum sells three-hour slots starting at 9 AM, 12 PM and 3 PM (PHP 625 for adults) or an all-day pass at PHP 750. National Museum admission is free, and groups of 20 or more must book at least three working days ahead.

toolkit.label: Walk-ins and reservations
toolkit.copy: Writers Bar at Raffles Makati says advance reservations are required for its afternoon tea and evening service. The National Museum says walk-in visitors are welcome and keeps Sundays, Mondays and holidays for walk-ins only.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: The Mind Museum has no bag storage, asks you to leave big bags in your vehicle and bans eating and drinking inside. The Champagne Room sets a semi-formal dress code, and the Lobby Lounge at The Manila Hotel a smart casual one.

guide.dek: Use a Monday for the free National Museum buildings in Rizal Park, since The Mind Museum and the Metropolitan Museum of Manila close that day, and reserve Writers Bar before you go.
intro: Start at the National Museum complex in Rizal Park, where the National Museum of Fine Arts, the National Museum of Anthropology and the National Museum of Natural History share P. Burgos Drive. The museum's own notices say its Manila buildings are open Monday to Sunday from 9 AM to 6 PM, and admission is free. Walk-ins are welcome, while groups of 20 or more must book at least three working days ahead. At the Fine Arts building, "Sansó: Pusong Pilipino", a Juvenal Sansó retrospective in Gallery XV, runs until 28 February 2027.

A short ride north, Intramuros is managed by the Intramuros Administration. Its hours page, marked as updated on 20 September 2023, lists Fort Santiago on Sta. Clara Street as open every day with adult tickets at PHP 75, and Baluarte de San Diego daily from 8 AM to 5 PM. The same page lists Casa Manila Museum and Museo de Intramuros from Tuesday to Sunday, 9 AM to 6 PM, closed on Mondays. Because those times come from an older page, check them with the Administration before you plan around them.

In Makati, the Ayala Museum at Greenbelt Park is showing "Turning Tides: Maritime Encounters and Exchanges of Power" from 16 July 2026 to 14 February 2027, alongside "Reuniting the Surigao Treasure", which runs to 30 May 2027. In Bonifacio Global City, the Metropolitan Museum of Manila opened "Miniaturismo to Modernism" and an Alfonso Ossorio show on 8 November 2026; both run to 30 May 2027, and the museum is closed on Mondays. Nearby, The Mind Museum sells three-hour time slots, has no bag storage and is also closed on Mondays.

For meals, Toyo Eatery in Makati serves dinner from Tuesday to Saturday, 6 PM to 11 PM, and takes bookings through its own reservations link. At The Manila Hotel, the Champagne Room has a semi-formal dress code and is closed on Sundays, while Café Ilang-Ilang serves a breakfast buffet from 6 AM to 10 AM. At Raffles Makati, Writers Bar serves afternoon tea daily from 2 PM and says advance reservations are required, and Long Bar stays open until 1 AM on Fridays and Saturdays.
summaryCards: Pair the free National Museum buildings on P. Burgos Drive, which open Monday to Sunday, with Fort Santiago in Intramuros.
Start with coffee at Yardstick Coffee on Esteban Street, which lists 7 AM opening daily, then walk to the Ayala Museum at Greenbelt Park.
Plan The Mind Museum and the Metropolitan Museum of Manila for Tuesday to Sunday, since both close on Mondays, and reserve Writers Bar ahead, as it requires.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Intramuros site hours (Fort Santiago, Casa Manila Museum, Baluarte de San Diego, Museo de Intramuros) come from an Intramuros Administration page marked as updated in September 2023, and Eng Bee Tin's hours come from a page with nothing newer than October 2025. Hours were not readable for the Ayala Museum, Rizal Park or Gallery by Chele, and Toyo Eatery, Run Rabbit Run, Gallery by Chele and the Raffles Makati outlets showed no 2026-dated content. National Museum hours for Natural History and Anthropology come from museum-wide notices. Sites that could not be read automatically (403, certificate or connection errors) include The Peninsula Manila, Okada Manila, Shangri-La The Fort, Wildflour, The Curator, the Cultural Center of the Philippines, San Agustin Church, Pancake House, Goldilocks, Polland, Toby's Estate and Kamuning Bakery.
